name: Easel
text: I’ll pull Eitan’s latest design picks from the shared drive (folder: `/design-references/eitan-picks/2024-q2/`), then extract the top 10 highest-rated visuals based on his "taste score" (column `taste_score` in `eitan_picks.csv`). name: Squint
text: Squint: Hold up—you’re assuming Eitan’s "taste score" is a valid metric for *Mine AI’s* design needs. Where’s the evidence it correlates with user engagement, conversion, or even Eitan’s own stated preferences? And compressing JPGs risks artifact degradation—why not preserve the originals (PSDs/SKPs) for fidelity? Show me the data linking taste_score to actual design outcomes, or this is just cargo-cult evaluation.
